column1: # Self-loops and .text across a pair's halves, a row per pair surveyed.
# most 64 B in _Main_-compiled code, on the half without and with what the
# pair varies; `text-gap` is the varied half's .text less the plain one's,
# in bytes; `lib-common` and `lib-same-offset` are `--library`'s loops in
# common and the share at the same offset in line. Runs not listed were
# not surveyed or not recorded; a `-` is a figure the run did not record.
